question: Does an explicitly linked, validated, source-backed small-library worked example improve first/final quality and reduce repairs versus the existing prescribed example?

conditions.B: Unchanged packaged Skill including existing prescribed examples
conditions.P: Same package plus one additional worked example and concise reference linked at Architecture example selection; no preparation helper or renderer changes

scope: p-retry and QuickLRU with unchanged previously visible tasks/pins. Both are known development cases, not unseen tasks; conclusions exploratory. lilconfig is not re-tested in this bounded round.

prototype.example_domain: synthetic document publishing controller with caller callbacks and conditional exits; contains no tested repository facts

quality: Original task clauses, exact source entailment including callback conditions, original showcase finalize and independent default-viewport visual judgement. Normal vertical scrolling allowed. No node/edge/card quotas. Preserve disagreements and all failures.
confirmation: Only if screen passes, reverse order one fresh pair per same task. No default promotion from initial pairs.
observability: Record first and final versions, all observed pre/post-finalize revisions and terminal receipts; native/public tools only. P reads of the added reference/example counted as exposure, not proof of comprehension. Full clock includes copying/dispatch and example reading. Capture/review separated.
integrity: Package delta is exact linked-reference/example allowlist for P; original source/tasks/runtime and all B package bytes unchanged. No author edits outside own build/output. Inputs frozen before any timed author; no replacement failures.
preservation: Original dirty checkout/live installs/remote unchanged. Local research commits only.
